'''The Sludge Fen'''{{coords|57|7|Barrens}} is an oil field the northeast corner of the [[Barrens]]. Occupied by the [[Venture Trading Company]] for their oil refining projects, the fen is one of the [[Oil platform]]s that can be visited in game. This is a dangerous area to adventure in, as the cowardly Venture Co. employees will rush for help if they are attacked. Sludge Fen is led by [[Tinkerer Sniggles]], [[Foreman Grills]] and [[Engineer Whirleygig]].
